specs.keyboard_notes: Magic Keyboard, Touch ID, Force Touch trackpad

offers.name: Apple MacBook Air 15.3" w/ Touch ID (2026) - Silver (Apple M5 / 24GB RAM / 1TB SSD) - English

reviews.quote: There is just nothing comparable in the Windows world.
It can easily last through a full workday without needing to recharge.
For many, it's the best Mac around.

praises: The complete Air: 24GB + 1TB + big quiet screen + great speakers in 1.51 kg
Handles Xcode + Docker + 50 Chrome tabs without fan noise (r/macbook)
Battery lasts multiple days of moderate use (Amazon.ca reviewers)
Best price-performance in its class — NBC says nothing Windows compares
High resale value keeps true cost of ownership low
complaints: At C$2,849 you're C$50 from an M6 MacBook Pro 14 — the perennial Air-vs-Pro debate (r/macbook)
Soldered RAM/SSD locks the config in permanently
60Hz notched LCD and only two ports at nearly C$3k
Fanless throttling keeps sustained multi-core behind the Pro
No HDMI/SDXC means creators still need a dock

design_philosophy: The ceiling of the Air line in Canada: maximum memory and storage Apple offers on the 15-inch without crossing into Pro territory. It's the 'buy once, keep for six years' Air.
rating_notes: Ratings inferred from directly-tested Air 15 M5 base (NBC 92%): RAM/storage bumps per parts 06/07 deltas. Image follows Apple specs-page CDN pattern. Sentiment from NBC cons + Amazon.ca aggregate; Reddit API blocked (403). RTINGS score quoted from the same-generation 13-inch M5 review (identical platform).
